model.name: repoRegistry.ooshRootFollowsHomeSymlink
model.description: The 'oosh' RepoRegistry root resolves by construction to os.homedir()+'/oosh' (the HOME/oosh SYMLINK path, NOT canonicalized), so git follows the symlink to the CURRENT oo-mode worktree dynamically - the center header (and diff + save) reflect the branch of whatever HOME/oosh points at now (mcdonges.latest). OOSH_DIR override dropped. Realized in RepoRegistry.resolve reading the pinned ROOTS.oosh. This makes R30.38's currentBranch/setCenterTitle chain show the CORRECT branch.
model.repointNote: method b9e8ba29 (GitApi.currentBranch, observable producer) -> 6f954137 (RepoRegistry.resolve, the confirmed correct-by-construction fix-site: oosh root = HOME/oosh symlink, drop OOSH_DIR). Renamed UC to the confirmed mechanism. currentBranch code was already correct (expert); the root resolution was the bug.
